description: Experience ultra-fast charging with the 80W SuperVOOC Fast Charging Cable, engineered to deliver reliable performance for modern smartphones. In addition to fast charging, the cable supports data transfer, allowing you to sync files, photos and videos between compatible devices. The 1-meter length offers the ideal balance of convenience and portability. Perfect for users looking for a reliable replacement or backup charging cable, this fast charging cable is built to support your everyday charging needs with speed, durability and efficiency.
